title: Lucifer deck
description: One TOML file: the lattice and the tables run, window, beam, field, wake, space_charge and bmad.

lattice.description: The Bmad lattice file. The FEL segments are its wigglers with fel_method set.

out_root.description: Root of every output file name.

interlude_model.description: Interlude transport: bmad (the seam) or genesis (transcribed).

transport_model.description: Transverse transport inside averaged FEL elements: bmad, Bmad's own kernel, or genesis, the transcribed maps for validation only.

unaveraged_steps_per_period.description: Integration steps per undulator period in unaveraged elements. Below 10 the push does not converge.

unaveraged_ramp_periods.description: Periods the field ramps over at each end of an unaveraged element. 0 keeps the default of 2, -1 is a hard edge.

source_model.description: The FEL source model: deposit, the per-particle scatter, or coherent, the coherent-Gaussian source.

source_filter.description: The angular filter on the source term, transcribed from Genesis4. Off to compare against a code without one.

source_filter_angle.description: The filter's edge as an angle. 0 derives it from the beam and the gain. [rad]

source_filter_tolerance.description: The largest fraction of source intensity the filter may remove inside the protected angle.

source_filter_xcut.description: The edge in Genesis4's own unit, the shifted grid index over ngrid. Validation only.

source_filter_ycut.description: The edge in Genesis4's own unit, the shifted grid index over ngrid. Validation only.

source_filter_width.description: The sigmoid's width as a fraction of its edge. Small is a sharp edge.

source_filter_mutate.description: Self-test of the filter check: apply the sigmoid to the propagated field instead of the source.

track_start.description: Element locator opening the walk. Blank is the first element.

track_end.description: Element locator closing the walk. Blank is the last element.

continuation.description: beam.file and field.file are a checkpoint pair the run continues from, not an initialization.

comb_ds_save.description: Minimum z advance between per-record stats rows. 0 is every record, negative is none. [m]

interlude_ds_step.description: The length an interlude element is cut into, for stats rows and frames along it. 0 tracks it whole. [m]

dump_beam_at.description: Element locators for mid-run beam dumps.

dump_field_at.description: Element locators for mid-run field dumps.

dump_at_comb.description: Write the beam and the field at every comb position as a frame series.

dump_slice_first.description: The first slice a frame carries, in window order.

dump_slice_last.description: The last slice a frame carries. -1 is the last slice of the window.

dump_reduced.description: Write the field's own reductions per record into the stats file.

ran_seed.description: The one random seed: generation, import and noise.

write_diag.description: Write the Genesis-comparison text diag file, which is large.

write_initial.description: Dump the initial state before tracking.

load_only.description: Build the initial state, dump it, stop.

keep_escaped_field.description: Keep the bank of field slices slippage carries out of the window.

migrate.description: Move particles between slices when their phase leaves the slice window.

reference_run.description: No FEL interaction: Bmad tracks everything.

record_environment.description: Record the login name and the working directory in meta/. Off, since a stats file travels.

fp32_check.description: The FP32 lockstep check: off, lockstep or freerun. For checks only.

fp32_mutate.description: The FP32 check's self-test: coarsen the residual.

device.description: The device backend: off, or metal on a build that carries it.

device_timing.description: Per-pass device timing, one compute encoder a pass. Slows the run.

device_dep_mutate.description: Shift the device deposit's fixed-point scale, in bits. A check instrument.

window_length.description: The time window. 0 derives it from the bunch, or is one slice. [m]

n_wavelength.description: Wavelengths per slice, Genesis4's sample. 0 derives it from the gain.

n_slice.description: The window as a slice count. 0 takes it from window_length. Both set is refused.

current.description: A flat current. 0 derives the current from the bunch's z structure. [A]

file.description: An openPMD particle dump to start from, already in slices. Blank loads a bunch instead.

position_file.description: An openPMD-beamphysics bunch to load, read whole and then sliced by load_mode.

n_particle.description: Macroparticles per slice after the phase copies, a positive multiple of beamlet_size. In the keep mode, the particles of the generated bunch.

bunch_charge.description: Total bunch charge. The current is derived from it and never input. [C]

sig_z.description: Bunch length, read with z_distribution. 0 is the steady state of one slice. [m]

z_distribution.description: The current profile: ran_gauss, a Gaussian of sig_z, or grid, flat from z_min to z_max.

z_min.description: The flat profile's lower z bound, read under grid only. [m]

z_max.description: The flat profile's upper z bound, read under grid only. [m]

load_mode.description: How the bunch becomes slices: sample, the same count in every slice with weights from the slice charge, or keep, every particle kept with the counts following the charge.

quiet_start.description: Load beamlets of beamlet_size phase copies, quiet below that harmonic.

beamlet_size.description: Copies per beamlet, and the harmonics the noise resolves.

shot_noise.description: Impose the physical noise on the load's groups. Time-dependent windows only.

write_genesis_dist.description: Write the bunch as a Genesis4 importdistribution file.

split_weights.description: Check instrument: coincident copies carrying 1/3 and 2/3 of each weight after loading.

swap_beam_xy.description: Check instrument: swap (x, px) with (y, py) after generation.

gen_test_weights.description: Check instrument: alternate beamlet weights of 0.25 and 1.75, charge preserving.

resample_split_weights.description: Check instrument: the split-weight copies applied to the bunch before it is sliced.

slice_width.description: Sampling window over bunch length, Genesis4's slicewidth.

n_particle_per_slice.description: Macroparticles per slice on the validation route.

beamlet_size.description: Beamlet size on the validation route.

n_slice.description: Slice count. 0 derives it from the bunch length and the spacing.

use_beam_init.description: Validation route: resample a bunch Bmad generated from [beam] instead of the analytic loader.

file.description: The openPMD wavefront file to start from, or one per harmonic member. Blank is a seed.

lambda0.description: The resonant wavelength. Required for generation. [m]

grid_n_pts.description: Transverse grid points per side. 0 derives it from the beam.

grid_half_width.description: Transverse grid half width. 0 derives it from the beam. [m]

seed_power.description: Gaussian seed power. 0 is a dark start. [W]

seed_polarization.description: The seed's polarization, x or y.

harmonics.description: The field set: 1 first, then further harmonic numbers in increasing order.

model.description: Which chamber-wake implementation runs: genesis, the transcribed solver.

radius.description: Chamber radius, or the half gap of a flat chamber. [m]

conductivity.description: DC conductivity. 0 is no resistive wake. [1/(Ohm m)]

roundpipe.description: A round chamber. False is flat, parallel plates.

material.description: CU or AL, a shortcut for the conductivity and relaxation.

gap.description: Undulator gap. 0 is no geometric wake. [m]

hrough.description: Roughness amplitude. 0 is no roughness wake. [m]

write_kernels.description: Check instrument: write the transcribed kernels to this file.

model.description: Which space-charge implementation runs: genesis, the transcribed solver.

rmax.description: Radial grid extent scale. It grows adaptively as Genesis4's does. [m]

nz.description: Longitudinal harmonics. 0 disables the short-range solve.

radiation_damping_on.description: Bmad's radiation damping in the interludes.

radiation_fluctuations_on.description: Bmad's radiation fluctuations in the interludes.

csr_and_space_charge_on.description: Bmad's master switch for CSR and space charge.

sc_min_in_bin.description: Bmad's minimum particles per space-charge bin.

particle_sigma_cutoff.description: Bmad's particle sigma cutoff for the space-charge mesh.
